# SAP Security Expert

> The leading community for SAP Security, GRC, and BTP professionals. Expert tutorials, best practices, and guides to protect your SAP landscape and advance your career.

## About

SAP Security Expert (https://sapsecurityexpert.com) is an independent community platform for SAP Security, SAP GRC, SAP BTP, SAP IAG, SAP S/4HANA Security, SAP Fiori Security, SAP Cybersecurity, SAP Analytics Cloud Security, SAP SuccessFactors Security, and SAP Cloud Identity Services professionals.

The platform publishes expert-written tutorials, best practices, guides, video content, podcasts, product reviews, and community resources. It is independently owned and operated and has no affiliation with SAP SE.
